name: CbCR Annual Publish
outcome: OECD BEPS Action 13 Country-by-Country Report build with internal consistency gates and anomaly-pattern surfacing in one artifact. gate_status (auto_pass / review_required) and anomaly_flags (e.g. profit-with-zero-employees) are recorded in output_payload per the §27 Human Accountability vocabulary; a PUBLIC release additionally requires a dual_control(2) preparer/tax-officer gate before disclosure -- both recorded now, enforced once HA-RETRO-1 wires runtime gating. Cross-links art-473-interquartile-benchmark (same underlying entity financial data, different arm's-length-range analysis) and art-456 GloBE safe-harbour.
